title: Web need: show which grid a sample uses and where yours differs
description:
## Need (for the web/docs session; not visuals)
- The Library's waveform should show which grid a sample uses (yours or the analysis's) and, when yours, where your markers differ from the analysis's (they are the corrections).
- The Score view's "How it was solved" should show the same `grid:` fact `apricity explain` prints.
- Later (not in this initiative): moving warp markers in the web app would write the same `warp` markers.

## Data the UI needs
Marker records with `beat` (GraphQL, after the contract change); the compile result's per-clip grid (`Timeline` explain data through `crates/apricity-web`).

## Verify
The web session's own tasks; this is done when the data is reachable from `web/src` data calls.
